name: 60614 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60614 (Chicago) has 336 nonprofit organizations. 144 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 119 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60614 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
